nodes.label: CMake build definition
nodes.rationale: Builds the Vulkan executable (C++20, Vulkan, GLFW 3.4 and GLM 1.0.1 via FetchContent), compiles every shader with glslc and stages shaders and assets next to the binary.

nodes.label: GL_GOOGLE_include_directive plus glslc -I
nodes.rationale: Core GLSL has no #include at all; glslc's extension plus giving it the same include directory the C++ compiler gets is what lets both languages spell the include line identically.

nodes.label: Coarse shader DEPENDS on every custom/*.glsl
nodes.rationale: glslc emits no dependency information for CMake to consume, so every shader is declared to depend on every shared header; deliberately coarse, costing a full rebuild of a handful of small files in exchange for never missing one.

nodes.label: Stamp files for shader and asset staging
nodes.rationale: A POST_BUILD command only fires when the target relinks, so editing an asset without touching a .cpp left the copy silently unrun and stale assets shipped; a stamp file depending on the asset glob makes the copy its own build step.

nodes.label: Globbed shader compilation to SPIR-V
nodes.rationale: CMake globs the shader directory recursively and compiles each .vert/.frag/.comp with glslc, which is why the successive shader renames (toChangeSimplePos to PosNormUV, Blinn to CookTorrance) needed no build-file change.
